featured_reviews.name: Gouresh Kadam Vaarasaa
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely shocked and disgusted by my experience at Street Foods by Punjab Grill. While eating biryani, I found a cockroach inside the raita that was served to me. This is not just unacceptable — it is a serious health hazard and a complete failure of basic hygiene standards.

Finding an insect in food clearly reflects negligence in kitchen cleanliness, food preparation, and quality control. Such carelessness puts customers’ health at risk and is absolutely intolerable from a restaurant that claims to serve quality food.

I have documented the incident and will be taking legal action and filing a formal complaint with the concerned food safety authorities. Strict action must be taken so that no other customer has to go through such a disgusting and dangerous experience.

I strongly advise others to think twice before dining here.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Food took 30 minutes to arrive, and even water was delayed.

Disappointing. Never ordering from here again.

featured_reviews.name: kunal sarvaiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
• I ordered the Paneer Paratha and Chhole from Punjab's street food, and I found the taste to be moderately good. 😄

• However, considering the price, I believe they should work on improving the taste and quality of their food to make it a more satisfying experience. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Gurav Nishita
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely the worst experience ever at Street Food by Punjab Grill in the Inorbit Mall food court. The staff behavior was shockingly bad. They completely ignored customers standing right in front of them and acted like they didn’t care at all. It felt like they had no interest in doing their job.

The service was extremely slow and unprofessional, and the attitude of the staff was careless and disrespectful. For a place that is part of a well-known brand, this kind of service is unacceptable. Customers deserve basic respect and attention, which was clearly missing here.

Very disappointing and frustrating experience. I would strongly not recommend this place to anyone unless the management seriously improves their staff training and customer service.

Now, I know why his dabeli is popular. We ordered four dabeli, of different variety and all were worth. So, we ordered Jain garam, Vaishnav garam, daana and meethi dabeli. The amazing part of Jain dabeli was it had raw banana stuffing with the usual ingredients and let me tell you it was damn tasty. Earlier, I was little sceptical but when I tasted it, all my doubts were cleared. Vaishnav was also very good and others too.
Another thing I liked is packaging. He doesn't pack them in newspapers, which is not good for our health owing to the ink it has.
All in all, this is the best place if you are craving for dabeli.

featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Saini
featured_reviews.review_text: I have visited Gupta Bhel and Pani Puri several times and my most recent visit was last week. It is a purely no-dine, street-side outlet located near SV Road, Malad, close to the SB Road area. The food quality is consistently good — their cheese chilli toast is outstanding and easily one of the best items on the menu. The pani puri is among the best in the area, with jumbo-sized puris and great taste. As expected for a popular chaat spot, the place is usually very crowded, and it clearly needs more space to manage the rush comfortably. There is no dedicated parking, which can be inconvenient given the busy location. Overall, it’s an excellent spot for quick, tasty chaat if you don’t mind the crowd and limited space.

They serve various varieties of Vada pav and Dosas too. I tried their cheese masala Vada pav and normal Vada pav. Both were quiet amazing. Each bite of Cheese masala Vada pav had amazing taste of cheese, their chutney and masalas. Highly recommend to have it once !!

featured_reviews.name: Sanket Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Place serves one of the best vada masala pavs in Mumbai which they refer to as butter vada pav.

Many of us are used to eating mix of tangy, spicy and sweet chutney with vada pav but this is a different version of vada pav. It is for those who only prefer their vada pavs rich and spicy rather than spicy and sweet.

The vada itself is of a satisfactory proportion so you don't feel like you are just eating pav. There is enough butter to elevate the taste and not ruin it. If you can't handle the spice you can ask them to make masala pav less spicy, which they do without comprising the taste of the vada pav. The cost of butter vada pav is 30.

The cheese version of butter vada pav is equally delicious. Had lots of shavings of cheese on inside and outside it did help to mellow down the spice.

Also ordered Mysore masala dosa which I felt wasn't Mysore masala dosa as it lacked the classical red dry chutney but i would say it was a well presented one. Loved the idea of deconstructing the dosa  and it's masala.

About the outlet, this is where i feel it stands out from rest of the vada pav outlets. It is exceptionally clean, had a washbasin equipped with filled soap dispenser, also has a restroom. The counter had a working sanitizer bottle which is a necessity.

The staff is polite and has a good attitude towards preparing food and serving people especially Mr. Shivam.

Overall this is one of the places in Mumbai if anyone is planning to have butter vada (masala)pav, certainly one of a kind in suburban Mumbai. You will have a pleasant experience cause of the quantity of the food, the pricing and the quality maintained by the staff.

featured_reviews.name: Karishma Ahuja
featured_reviews.review_text: Legit the BEST Vada pav, Masala pav I've ever had! Other snacks like dosa & sandwiches are also good.. But vada pav is the best. Schezwan vada pav, Schezwan cheese vada pav, Cheese vada pav, Butter vada pav, Mayo vada pav.. every variety is superb! The chutneys served have a very good taste.. must try!

featured_reviews.name: Falguni P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Famous spot for vada pav and dosa.
*Food- they serve different types of vada pav, must try their Butter Vada pav and Schezwan vada pav.
Mayo vada pav was okay to taste.
They add different types of chutney which makes it spicy.
Tried their sada dosa and cheese chilly dosa.
Cheese chilly dosa is quite heavy, loaded with cheese, the gravy is enough for two people you'll need extra dosa to finish it.
The sada dosa is sprinkled with spicy masala and is crispy thin.
*Ambience - the place is small, no chairs available but you can stand and keep the plate on counter and eat.
The kitchen is outside so there is less space to go inside.

*Price - the menu is little overpriced

*Attributes - limited parking space available outside 🅿️✅
Wash basin is located inside,
There are stairs to go inside so it's not accessible ♿ ❌
Takeway and catering service available
They accept digital payment.
Ideal for quick bites
